content.short: CaveWorld is an immersive turn-based battle game where players compete for unique on-chain assets.
content.description: CaveWorld delivers an immersive turn-based battler experience where players duel one another by strategically leveraging an assortment of abilities and items. Each battle challenges you to outthink your opponent, time moves precisely, and choose the right tools to gain the upper hand. As you level up, your fighter grows stronger and earns rewards that become increasingly valuable, helping you defeat rivals in future bouts or trade these assets on the marketplace. The game emphasizes tactical decision-making and ongoing progression through rewards in every match.
